preprocessing: RGB, stretched (not letterboxed) to input_size x input_size with bilinear resampling, float32, (x/255 - 0.5)/0.5, NCHW

outputs.boxes: float32 [1, 12828, 4] x1,y1,x2,y2 in input pixels (anchors decoded in-graph)

postprocessing: src/onnx_backend.postprocess: score > confidence_threshold, top-k by score, greedy NMS at nms_threshold, keep max_detections, clip to input, scale to original pixels

_comment: torchvision's SSDlite anchors are relative to the input: its defaults (0.2..0.95) give a smallest anchor of 128 px at 640, larger than most plates here.
Measured on synthetic:train (every 10th sample, input stretched to 640): defaults leave only 25% of plates with any anchor at IoU>=0.5 (median best IoU 0.26); 0.05..0.5 gives 83% (median 0.60).
Same number of anchors per location, same layer shapes, same COCO weights loaded -- only the prior box sizes change.
To run torchvision's defaults exactly, set min_ratio 0.2 and max_ratio 0.95. docs/baseline_v1.md section 3.6.
